briefTitle: Gilteritinib for the Treatment of ALK NSCLC

typedChecks.sourceText: Age ≥ 18
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0-2
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0-2

typedChecks.sourceText: Absolute neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1500/mcL
Platelets ≥ 100,000/mcL
Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL without transfusion or erythropoietin (EPO) dependency (within 7 days of assessment)
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Hemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL without transfusion or erythropoietin (EPO) dependency (within 7 days of assessment)

typedChecks.sourceText: Measured or calculated creatinine clearance (CrCl) ≥ 50mL/min (calculated per Cockcroft-Gault formula)
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Measured or calculated creatinine clearance (CrCl) ≥ 50mL/min (calculated per Cockcroft-Gault formula)

typedChecks.sourceText: Serum total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 X upper limit of normal (ULN) (per institutional guidelines) OR direct bilirubin ≤ ULN for subjects with total bilirubin levels > 1.5 ULN
typedChecks.stringValue: 1.5 X upper limit of normal (ULN) (per institutional guidelines) OR direct bilirubin ≤ ULN for subjects with total bilirubin levels > 1.5 ULN
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Serum total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 X upper limit of normal (ULN) (per institutional guidelines) OR direct bilirubin ≤ ULN for subjects with total bilirubin levels > 1.5 ULN

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: The patient must belong to one of the following treatment cohorts.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy rules are complex and divided across three different multi-line cohorts.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 criteria assessed per screening imaging
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: If a cancerous lesion is easily and safely accessible, a pre-treatment biopsy of this lesion is strongly encouraged but NOT required prior to first dose of gilteritinib.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or encouragement to undergo a biopsy is a judgment-based rule, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: At least 7 days must have elapsed since last anti-neoplastic TKI, chemotherapy, immunotherapy, or investigational agent prior to the first dose of gilteritinib
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Washout window spanning multiple therapy classes is not a simple typed lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Received palliative radiation within 7 days of enrollment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Palliative radiation washout window is not a typed lab check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has a concurrent active malignancy receiving interventional therapy unless it is the investigator's opinion that the concurrent active malignancy will NOT significantly impact the survival of the patient
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator opinion regarding concurrent active malignancy is a subjective judgment.
